themes.title: Themes & Customization
themes.description: Design your soundboard your way. Custom colors, layouts, and profiles so the UI fits your setup — desktop, stream overlay, or VR.

tabs.title: Organize with Tabs & Colors
tabs.description: Group sounds into colored tabs. Find what you need in milliseconds — even with huge libraries.

recording.title: Easy & Fast Recording
recording.description: Capture PC audio straight into SoundNinja with the Record Editor. Trim, name, and drop onto your board in seconds.

performance.title: Performance & Lightweight
performance.description: Rust core via Tauri v2. Low RAM, tiny footprint, and pre-cached sounds for instant playback.

opensource.title: Free & Open Source
opensource.description: Licensed under GPL-3.0. Fork it, improve it, share it — no paywalls, no telemetry tax.

cta.subtitle: Download SoundNinja free — or contribute on GitHub.
